slots.name: capital expenditures
slots.sentence: In its first earnings report as a public company, SpaceX said its capital expenditures jumped to $18.4 billion in the second quarter, up nearly seven times from $2.8 billion a year ago.

slots.name: quarterly revenue
slots.sentence: The spending overshadowed a 92 percent increase in revenue to $7.8 billion.

slots.name: quarterly loss
slots.sentence: SpaceX also posted a quarterly loss of $541 million, narrower than the $1 billion loss in the same period a year ago.

slots.name: stock decline
slots.sentence: The results and Mr. Musk’s comments sent SpaceX’s shares down more than 10 percent in after-hours trading, underlining how drumming up excitement for the company’s public offering may have been easier than keeping that excitement going.

slots.name: Starlink subscribers
slots.sentence: Starlink increased subscribers to 12 million, up from 6 million in the same period last year.

slots.name: Starlink revenue
slots.sentence: Its revenue rose 66 percent to $4.3 billion.

slots.name: launch revenue
slots.sentence: Revenue from space launches grew nearly 29 percent to $962 million, though losses in that business widened to $542 million.

slots.name: big tech capital expenditures
slots.sentence: And from April through June, those four companies’ capital expenditures totaled $170 billion, up 72 percent from a year earlier.
